Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal system tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Refer to System Event Codes below

Message.Name: Derivative Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Nasdaq disseminates options symbol directory messages for all active options symbols in the system.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal System tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the option root symbol (security symbol)

Field.Name: Expiration Year
Field.Description: Last two digits of the year of the option expiration

Field.Name: Expiration Month
Field.Description: Expiration Month of the option (1-12)

Field.Name: Expiration Day
Field.Description: Day of the Month of expiration (1-31)

Field.Name: Explicit Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Option Type
Field.Description: "C" = Call option, "P" = Put option, "N" = Not Applicable

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the unique symbol assigned to the underlying security within the Exchange System.

Field.Name: Closing Type
Field.Description: Denotes which System Event is used to determine when trading ceases in this symbol.

Field.Name: Tradable
Field.Description: Denotes whether or not this option is tradable at the exchange.

Field.Name: MPV
Field.Description: Minimum Price Variation for this option.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Message.Name: Trading Action Message
Message.Description: The options system uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of an index or equity option within the options market.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal System Tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the options security in the options market.

Message.Name: Best Bid And Ask Update Short Form Message
Message.Description: The options system will continuously calculate its best bid and offer position for active options contracts on the options market during the trading day.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal system tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Instrument ID assigned daily, valid for trading day

Field.Name: Quote Condition
Field.Description: Quote condition

Field.Name: Bid Market Order Size
Field.Description: Number of market order contracts on the bid side

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: Best bid price in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: Aggregated number of contracts on the bid side being displayed in the options market at the current time.

Field.Name: Bid Cust Size
Field.Description: Customer quantity on the bid side.

Field.Name: Bid ProCust Size
Field.Description: Customer professional quantity on the bid side.

Field.Name: Ask Market Order Size
Field.Description: Number of market order contracts on the ask side

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: Best ask price in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits

Field.Name: Ask Size
Field.Description: Aggregated number of contracts on the ask side being displayed in the options market at the current time.

Field.Name: Ask Cust Size
Field.Description: Customer quantity on the ask side.

Field.Name: Ask ProCust Size
Field.Description: Customer professional quantity on the ask side.

Message.Name: Best Bid Update Short Form Message
Message.Description: The options system will continuously calculate its best bid and offer position for active options contracts on the options market during the trading day.
